name: Kashima Neo
source:
Neo is a second year student at Chihaya High who wants to become a food journalist. She is a part-time worker at the Cubic Cafe, the same place where [url=/c7874]Shougo[/url] works. Neo is [url=/c7875]Mifu[/url]'s older sister, and she devotedly cares for her.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/You_that_became_a_Memory_~Memories_Off~]Wikipedia[/url] and partly translated from the [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/omokimi/chara.html]Official Site[/url].]
